'Initial commit' (2020-05-01 05:54), 'Update README.md' (05:55), 'All Projects' (05:56) — the entire archive landed in one upload.

strongest_counter_evidence: One-for-one match between the README's 13 claimed projects and the 13 directories in the listing
It is an archive of completed 2019-2020 fellowship coursework, so a single-day upload is the expected shape, not a red flag
counter_evidence_review.review_notes: The single-day, three-commit history could read as a one-shot dump, but for a coursework archive that is the honest pattern. Curation is explicitly not slop under the fairness rules. Minor defects: two table rows (IPL analysis, soil texture) link to the wrong or duplicated directory paths.

evidence_conflicts: README table's 'IPL Data Analysis' row links to the '2014 General Elections' directory path even though a correct 'Data Driven Design Thinking - IPL Data Analysis' directory exists in the listing — a link error, not a missing artifact.

notes: A 2020 coursework portfolio: 13 fellowship projects (analytics, ML, design thinking, case studies) each present as a directory and cataloged in a README table with mentors and tools, so all curation claims are artifact-backed.
